acs.text_first_line: AC1 The request carries the treatment values and the pinned template version
AC2 A missing merge value is refused and nothing is generated
AC3 The reference is stored with the decision record in one transaction
AC4 A repeated request with the same key returns the first reference and writes once
AC5 The record names the template code and version, and a record failure stops the call
AC6 A refusal or a 503 leaves the treatment unchanged
AC7 The generated document shows on SCR-14 through the composite route
AC8 No personal data reaches the event, the merge payload or the logs
